title: Mobile App Engineer
description:
**Primary Skillset:** 
 Dart,
 
 Flutter, State\\-Machine Design, Advanced OOPs Concepts, Mobile OS Architecture
 



**Years of Work Ex:** 
 1\\-3 yrs
 



**Minimum Qualifications:** 
 Bachelors in Computer Science, Engineering or similar
 



**Location:** 
 Nariman Point, Mumbai
 



**Timings:** 
 10am – 7pm; Monday to Friday
 



**Work Type:** 
 On\\-Site, 5 days a week
 



  





**Company Description:** 




 PaisaSmart is the operating brand name for Elixir Equities Pvt. Ltd. (EEPL), a financial services firm with operations in Prop Trading, Stock Broking, Portfolio Management \\& Mutual Fund distribution, and over 20 years in wealth management under founders who are recognised industry leaders.
 



  





 Our mission is to build wealth for the next 100m Indians. PaisaSmart is how — a WhatsApp chatbot and an Android/iOS app that make investing simple for people who have never invested.
 



  





 We ship fast. We work under broker, RA, PMS and MFD licences, so we ship fast without being careless with other people’s money — doing both is the actual job.
 



  





 Our values are humility, curiosity and passion. Socials: YT · Insta · LinkedIn. Try the product: message 8808990978 on WhatsApp.
 



  





**Application Process:** 



1. Apply on our site. Screening happens immediately by our recruitment AI agent, no waiting immediate pass/fail.
2. One day of in\\-person interviews at our offices (you select a convenient date \\& time) with the founder and team.
3. If we like you we make a decision immediately and share an offer. No long process, no multi stage screening.



  





**What You’ll Own:** 



1. The PS Mobile App: You’ll be the only and most senior developer responsible for maintenance, debugging and incremental feature build on the PS Mobile App. Your only escalation point is the founder who has built the app.
2. Agentic AI capabilities in the App: The PS app is very different to typical step per screen, API per screen app, it’s closer to an agentic harness with a server driven architecture. Maintaining it and building additional server\\-driven capabilities will be your task.
3. End to End Release workflow: Release the App into the testing environment, collect and debug errors. Submit final app versions to App \\& Play store, it’s all your responsibility.



  





**How We Work:** 



* Small team, highly collaborative but individual responsibilities. Growth isn’t gated on tenure. If you can do the next job, you get it.
* You work directly with the founder. No layer in between, nobody to hide behind. No office politics, no blame games, direct visibility.
* High responsibility, high level of freedom, minimal guidance. Find a problem, design a solution, fix it. You own your work end to end, including when something goes wrong at 9pm.
* If you’re right you’re right. No hierarchy, no “do it cause the boss said so”. Best argument wins, regardless of who made it.
* Everyone is expected to do 2\\-3 different tasks. With AI tooling enabling us to learn and do more than ever before come in with one core skillset and learn \\& apply 1\\-2 completely new skills with us.



  





**Who This Is For:** 



* You teach yourself things nobody assigned you.
* The problem is clear, the solution isn’t, and that excites you.
* You want real responsibility and opportunity to make an impact immediately.



  





**Who It Isn’t For:** 



* You want a defined ladder and a manager who assigns your work.
* You want remote or hybrid. This is on\\-site, five days, and we’re not flexible.
* You’d rather specialise narrowly than learn new things.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Strong Flutter and Dart, with real depth in async — futures, streams, concurrency, and the ability to debug something that hangs rather than working around it.
* Solid state management (bloc/cubit) and the judgement to model a complex flow as states and transitions rather than a tangle of conditions.
* You've built and released mobile apps end to end — app store submission, release cycles, crash monitoring and the fixes that follow.
* A working understanding of what the OS does underneath: app lifecycle, background execution, push notifications, permissions.
* Comfortable debugging across the network boundary. You can read the requests and responses between app and server and work out where things went wrong.
* Backend fundamentals: object\\-oriented design, data structures and algorithms, and enough Python to read our API code and follow a bug into it.
* **Nice to have:** 
 experience building against a complex or stateful backend — chat apps, offline\\-first sync, fintech, or anything where the server holds most of the truth.



  





**Compensation:** 



* 15 days paid vacation.
* Salary is competitive and varies substantially based on the skillset of an individual candidate.
* EEPL offers an ESOP program to select employees.
